story.title: The Round Ball
story.text: In a far corner of the cosmos, a little ball lost its shape. It traveled from planet to planet, learning the magic of CSS to become round again. Each world holds a secret — colors, sizes, and the space between things. Your code is the spell that brings the ball back to life.

level.wrongProperty: You got the look you wanted — well done! But the property to use here is {{property}}.
level.hint2: The answer shape is hidden. Click to reveal.
